name: Zooniverse Citizen Science
what_you_do: You help real researchers. You classify images, audio and text. There are hundreds of online projects.
who_can_apply: Open to volunteers online. The pages read state no age rule; check the user agreement.
pay_detail: No cost stated on the pages read; it is a volunteer research site
how_to_apply: Go to zooniverse.org, pick a project, and make an account if the project asks.
notes: The home page and FAQ do not state a minimum age. Projects span arts, biology, climate, history, language, medicine, nature, physics, space and social science.
